summary.en: Kogoro is in the hospital after his leg injured by a criminal he was chasing down. While there, he witnesses a silhouette of one person stabbing another person in the back. He notifies the nurses immediately, only to find out that the room in which the murder took place is empty. This happens continuously for three nights in a row, before an actual murder has taken place on the 4th night. Even worse, Kogoro is found passed out next to the corpse and mistaken to be the killer, and now Conan will have to clear his name. Missing Person (Murdered - First day) Location: East Beika General Hospital Victim: First person Time: 11:00-11:30 p.m Cause of death: Stab wound in the back Suspects: Katsutoshi Eto, Mitsuo Shirai, Keiko Okita and Kazumi Nakayama Kogoro always witnessed the murder occurring every night at exactly 11:00 p.m. Every time, he witnessed the murder occurring, dialed 110 (for the police). Every time when he went to the room where the murder occurred, the body was no where to be found. All of the patients, nurses, and doctors were wondering where the victim is and if there was a victim at all. Missing Person (Murdered - Second and Fourth Day) Location: East Beika General Hospital Victim: Second person Time: 11:00-11:30 p.m Cause of death: Stab wound in the back Suspects: Katsutoshi Eto, Mitsuo Shirai, Keiko Okita and Kazumi Nakayama Kogoro always witnessed the murder, when he looked into the room, the victim wasn't there. He always felt like he was hallucinating. He kept dialing 110 but the body wasn't found. Where's was the body hidden? Doctor Mitsuo said that Kogoro was most likely hallucinating because he had been involved in many murder cases. Conan starting investigating the room where the murders had been supposedly occurring. Missing Person (Murdered - Fifth Day) Location: East Beika Hospital Victim: Third victim Suspects: Katsutoshi Eto, Mitsuo Shirai, Keiko Okita and Kazumi Nakayama While Conan was awake at 11:30 p.m, he witnessed the murder along with Kogoro. Conan decided to stay with Kogoro to watch the murders to see if would still occur and it did. Doctor Mitsuo set the alarm on the clock to 11:00. At 11:30, they witnessed the real murder. Kogoro was struck in the head and knocked unconscious, with his fingerprints on the knife. Location: East Beika General Hospital Victim: Kogoro Mouri Attack Types: Bashing Suspects: Mitsuo Shirai, Keiko Okita and Kazumi Nakayama He was put to sleep. Kogoro, who had been struck, believes that he is Doctor Eto's murderer. Ran, who learned what was very shocked and terrified that her father was a suspect for a murder. Conan says that we (Conan and Kogoro) witnessed the crime taking place from his room. But, Megure said that Conan could be covering for Kogoro to protect him. Location: East Beika General Hospital Victim: Katsutoshi Eto Cause of death: Stab wound in the back Suspect: Kogoro Mouri He was stabbed to death. Conan after investigating is able to pin down the true culprit.
